message:
With storm season upon us, I’ve found it’s always a bit of a balancing act between keeping the kids entertained and letting them know we should be prepared. Just the other day, I was trying to explain to my grandkids why we should have a little emergency kit ready. They were more interested in building a fort with the supplies than understanding the importance of it all. 

But I guess that’s the beauty of it—prepping can turn into a fun activity if we play our cards right. So, if you’re looking for some solid tips on how to get ready for storms without turning it into a doom-and-gloom scenario, I’ve got a fantastic resource for you. 

What are some tricks you use to engage your little ones when it comes to emergency prep? 🏠
